audit_name: Infrastructure Verification Closure & Final Release Gate

claims_verdict.basis: 10/10 in-memory durability tests passed; 3/3 live Firestore emulator tests passed with document nesting, OCC transactions, and store restart survival.
Canonical idempotency keys, transactional operation claims, and crash recovery proven across 12 concurrency tests, 6 idempotency tests, and 1 OS multiprocessing test.
41 core tests + 21 adversarial tests prove LLM reasoning is advisory and cannot mark outcomes verified or bypass policy constraints without deterministic evidence.
20 security tests verify cryptographic signature validation, role-based access control, tenant isolation, and authoritative approver stamping.

ResilientGemini rate limiter (>= 6.5s interval), circuit breaker (trips at 5 failures), exponential backoff with jitter, and UNKNOWN crash state transitions pass 14 unit tests and 7 live Gemini scenarios.
StructuredJsonFormatter produces valid JSON with contextvars (request_id, workflow_id, tenant_id); recursive redaction masks all credentials, tokens, and API keys.
GET /metrics exports low-cardinality Prometheus text; GET /api/health and GET /api/ready verified on live container.
Multi-stage Dockerfile compiled into recoveryos:phase5-7; launched live with non-root appuser (UID 10001), passed healthcheck, and drained tasks on SIGTERM within 5s.
Proven for single-replica / process-isolated workloads (max-instances=1). Multi-replica deployments require a shared Redis rate limiter or Cloud Tasks queue in Phase 6.
